Subject: Tidy Up Vendor Agreements Inbox

Hi Assistant,

Could you please help me tidy up the Vendor Agreements inbox? I'd like you to archive any unnecessary threads and then send a one-paragraph reply to the Records list detailing which threads you archived.

Thank you!

Best,  
[Your Name]

I can do that, but I need two quick clarifications before I make any changes:

1) What do you mean by "unnecessary threads"? For example, should I archive threads that match any of these rules (pick one or give different instructions):
   - Older than X months/years (tell me X), 
   - Contain keywords like "newsletter", "promotion", or "auto-reply", 
   - Have no attachments and no unread messages, 
   - Or threads you marked with a particular label (please name it)?

2) Which email address should I send the one-paragraph report to? ("Records list" could be records@company.com, records@company.org, a Google Group, or a distribution list—please provide the exact address to use.)

If you prefer, I can propose a default clean-up policy and proceed:
- Archive threads in the "Vendor Agreements" folder that are older than 24 months OR contain the keywords "newsletter", "promotion", or "unsubscribe", and that have no unread messages.  
If that works, confirm the Records list recipient and I will:
- Archive the matching threads, and
- Send a one-paragraph reply to the Records list summarizing which threads were archived (I'll include subject lines and dates).

Which option do you want?
Let's go with the default clean-up policy you proposed. Please send the report to records@company.com. Thank you!

args.subject: Vendor Agreements Inbox Cleanup Report
args.body:
Hello Records team,

I performed the cleanup of the "Vendor Agreements" mailbox using the agreed default policy (archive threads older than 24 months OR containing keywords "newsletter", "promotion", or "unsubscribe", and with no unread messages). No matching threads were found in the Vendor Agreements folder/label, so no messages were archived.

If you’d like me to broaden the search (for example, across the entire inbox or using additional keywords or labels), tell me the changes and I’ll run another pass.

Best,
[Your Name]

content: Done — I applied the default cleanup policy to the "Vendor Agreements" folder/label and sent the one-paragraph report to records@company.com. I found no matching threads to archive.
